orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Lok Pal Singh
orders.text:
WPMS No.3433 of 2019 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Ajay Veer Pundir, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
 Mr. J.P. Joshi, Additional Advocate 
General with Mr. I.P. Kohli, Standing 
Counsel and Mr. Narain Dutt, Brief Holder 
for the State. 
 Urgency Application (IA No.5719 of 
2020) is allowed. Miscellaneous Application 
(IA No.3130 of 2020) is also allowed. 
Supplementary affidavit filed by the State is 
taken on record. 
 Impleadment Application No.2011 of 
2020 is also allowed. 
 Let necessary amendment be 
incorporated impleading the new party as a 
party respondent. 
 Issue notice to the newly impleaded 
party fixing 27.07.2020. Steps be taken 
within a week. 
 Learned State Counsel prays for and is 
granted time to file an objection against the 
Amendment Application (CLMA No.2010 of 
2020) by 27.07.2020. 
 List this case on 27.07.2020. 
 
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.) 30.06.2020
Ravi

WPMS No.3433 of 2019
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Ajay Veer Pundir, Advocate 
(through video conferencing) and 
Mr. Mukesh Rawat, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. Suyesh Pant, Standing 
Counsel and Mr. J.S. Bisht, Brief 
Holder for the State/respondent 
nos.1, 2 and 3.
Mr. Imraj Rautela, Advocate 
holding brief of Mr. Shobhit Saharia, 
Advocate for respondent no.4. 
Heard on Misc. Application (IA) 
Nos.16082 of 2023 and 16083 of 
2023. 
By means of these 
applications, the State requires that 
the original record which has been 
requisitioned in the matter may be 
returned, as it is required for the 
other purposes, as well. 
Learned State counsel would 
submit that Special Appeal No.1021 
of 2019, this Court had
requisitioned the record pertaining 
to the case. While deciding the 
Special Appeal on 08.01.2020, the 
record has been remitted to the 
Registrar (Judicial) of the Court with 
the directions that it may be placed 
before the Court at the time of 
hearing. Learned State counsel would 
submit that there is need of record 
for a week or so. 
Learned counsel for the 
petitioner has no objection on it. 
Let the record be given back to 
the authority from where it was 
requisitioned with the direction to 
submit it back after six weeks.
Misc. Application (IA) 
Nos.16082 of 2023 and 16083 of 
2023, stand allowed accordingly. 
 
(Ravindra Maithani, J.)
08.08.2023
Sanjay
